name: jevmem
description: jevmem: shared project rules and memory for Claude Code, and its side pane

plugins.name: jevmem
plugins.description: jevmem keeps your project's decisions, rules and failed approaches in JEVMEM.md in your repo, shared with your team through git, and checks Claude's commands and edits against those rules before they run. It saves them from your chats and brings the relevant lines back next session, beside Claude Code's own memory. Needs the jevmem CLI from npm and a TypeSafe API key. Opt-in per project.

plugins.name: jevmem-pane
plugins.description: A side pane for Claude Code beside your chat: what jevmem recalled for this prompt, what its guard decided, and what the last turn saved, with why, wrong and forget buttons. Reads three local files in .jevmem/ and runs the jevmem command; sends nothing anywhere. Needs the jevmem CLI, a project that is turned on, and Claude Code 2.1.299 or newer.
